rows.question: I am at this station with no signal. Which pharmacies are within walking distance?

sources.title: GPS: position from satellites
sources.passage: Receiving satellite signals is different from downloading an online map. A receiver can therefore calculate coordinates without a data connection. To show those coordinates on a map, the application must also have the map available. This is an educational explanation, not a test of any particular application.

sources.title: Compass: orientation and the magnetic field
sources.passage: The geomagnetic field sensor measures magnetic field strength on three axes. Android can combine this information with the accelerometer to estimate device orientation relative to magnetic north.

sources.title: Compass: orientation and the magnetic field
sources.passage: Orientation and position are different quantities: a compass indicates a direction, while GPS estimates coordinates. Magnetic north does not necessarily match geographic north. Android provides tools to calculate magnetic declination, which depends on location and time.
